title: Shoebox Fee Entries on Returned Footwear
content:
**Returns & Exchanges — desk action reference: shoebox fees on returned footwear.**

## The rule

Once a return is in status inspected, the returns desk withholds one shoebox fee for each footwear line whose units came back without their original box, in a damaged box or in a box used as the shipping carton. A Standard Return, a Store Credit Return and a Gift Return carry it; an exchange or a Quality Issue Return never does. Each fee is entered on the return as a shoebox fee entry on its line and lowers what is owed to the customer.

| Box condition recorded at inspection for a footwear line | Shoebox fee on a Standard Return, Store Credit Return or Gift Return |
|---|---|
| No original box | Withheld |
| Original box damaged, or used as the shipping carton | Withheld |
| Original box intact | None |

Size Exchanges, Instant Exchanges and Quality Issue Returns carry no shoebox fee in any box condition.

## What the action does

`assess_box_fee_f48699d7` enters, on the return's money ledger, one shoebox fee for one booked footwear line whose units came back without their original box or in a damaged box or a box used as the shipping carton, dated today. The fee lowers what is owed to the customer on the return by its amount. After the call the fee appears among the return's settlement entries as a missing box fee.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side action of the returns desk, outside the standing tool list: the agent unlocks it by its exact name, `assess_box_fee_f48699d7`, and then calls it, once per footwear line.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `return_id` | The RMA number of the return carrying the footwear units, as shown by the return lookup | Identifier, exactly as shown |
| `booked_line_id` | The reference number of the order's footwear booking line the fee is charged on, as shown on the return's inspection entries | Identifier, exactly as shown |
| `fee_amount_usd` | The shoebox fee withheld for the line | USD, a non-negative amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when the fee is fully waived; recorded as a deduction |

## What comes back

- **Success:** a confirmation sentence naming the new fee entry reference (a reference beginning "rs"), the RMA number, the booking line and the fee withheld in USD with 2 decimal places. The entry reference means the fee was booked.
- **Error:** when no return exists under the RMA number given, the action answers "Error: no return" with that number and records nothing.
